nodes.title: Backend Architecture
nodes.content:
# Django Backend System

**Project Structure:**
```
Cybersecurity-School-Project/
├── cyberlearn/     # Main project config
├── learning/       # Core app
└── manage.py       # Django manager
```

**File Locations:**
- Settings: `cyberlearn/settings.py`
- URLs: `cyberlearn/urls.py` + `learning/urls.py`
- WSGI: `cyberlearn/wsgi.py`

nodes.title: Settings & Config
nodes.content:
## `cyberlearn/settings.py`

**Installed Apps:**
- django.contrib.admin
- django.contrib.auth
- rest_framework
- rest_framework_simplejwt
- corsheaders
- learning (custom)

**Key Settings:**
- DEBUG mode from `.env`
- ALLOWED_HOSTS from `.env`
- JWT Token lifetime: 5 mins
- Refresh Token: 24 hours
- CORS enabled for frontend

nodes.title: Views & Endpoints
nodes.content:
## `learning/views.py`

**Key ViewSets:**
- `LessonViewSet` - CRUD lessons
- `UserProgressViewSet` - Track progress

**Custom Views:**
- `CookieTokenObtainPairView` - Login
- `CookieTokenRefreshView` - Refresh JWT
- `LogoutView` - Clear cookies
- `AuthStatusView` - Check auth
- `RegisterView` - User signup
- `CurrentUserView` - User details

**Utilities:**
- `_set_auth_cookies()` - HttpOnly cookies
- `submit_answer()` - Task submission
- `set_level()` - Update user level

nodes.title: URL Routing
nodes.content:
## `learning/urls.py`

**Main Routes:**
```
/api/lessons/          (GET, POST, PATCH)
/api/progress/         (GET, POST, PATCH)
/api/token/            (POST) - Login
/api/token/refresh/    (POST) - Refresh
/api/logout/           (POST) - Logout
/api/auth/status/      (GET) - Check auth
/api/register/         (POST) - Signup
/api/users/me/         (GET) - Current user
/api/notes/            (GET) - User notes
/api/tasks/<id>/submit/  (POST) - Submit answer
/api/set-level/        (POST) - Set level
```

nodes.title: Authentication
nodes.content:
## `learning/authentication.py`

**Custom Class:**
- `CookieJWTAuthentication`

**Process:**
1. Extract token from HttpOnly cookie
2. Verify JWT signature
3. Attach user to request
4. Raise on invalid token

**Security:**
- HttpOnly (no JS access)
- SameSite=Lax
- Secure flag for HTTPS

nodes.title: Serializers
nodes.content:
## `learning/serializers.py`

**Main Serializers:**
- `LessonSerializer`
- `ContentBlocksSerializer`
- `TaskBlocksSerializer`
- `UserProgressSerializer`
- `NoteSerializer`
- `UserSerializer`
- `RegisterSerializer`
- `UserProfileSerializer`

**Purpose:**
- Validate incoming data
- Serialize model data to JSON
- Handle nested relations

nodes.title: Database Models
nodes.content:
## `learning/models.py`

**Models:**
- **Lesson** - Learning units
- **ContentBlocks** - Text/code content
- **TaskBlocks** - Quiz questions
- **UserProgress** - Level & score tracking
- **UserProfile** - User bio
- **Note** - User notes

**Signals:**
- Auto-create UserProfile on User creation
- Auto-save UserProfile

nodes.title: Middleware & Security
nodes.content:
## Security Features

**Installed:**
- CORS Headers - Cross-origin requests
- REST Framework throttling
- JWT token blacklist

**Configuration:**
- DEFAULT_PERMISSION_CLASSES = IsAuthenticated
- DEFAULT_AUTHENTICATION_CLASSES = CookieJWTAuthentication
- Throttle rates: 1000/day (user), 100/day (anon)
